content.content: no element of vqultolm contradicts uuutyrzs or ympqvvwr or mspmqvuk; fail on any contradicting element, naming the element
content.rationale: the dependent is inline prose, so it is natural-layer; uuutyrzs is inline prose (natural-to-natural, the gate cell), while mspmqvuk is an inline visual-spec (structured parent, natural child) and ympqvvwr is a ref to a source contract (code parent, natural child), cells no eval-matrix row covers, so those two take the default cell: the gate form, flagged for a matrix entry. A prose child commits in words, so its prerequisites can settle only whether the commitment contradicts them: the check reads the committed statement, including every exclusion it states, against the three prerequisites and names any element of the commitment a prerequisite contradicts. A behavioural check over the committed set would demand behaviour from a prose dependent and restate it, which the gate form forbids.
